10 REM! INTEGER J,K
20 DIM P$(1)
30 PRINT (((Y<=C%))--K),SGN(.001 AND C)>C%,
40 Z%=AB
50 Y=N2:GET K:Z%=K OR (TAN(B))
60 K=(EXP(COS(C))):Y=K AND N2
70 Z%=J:C=Z% AND Z%
80 RECALL A:K=C%=((RND(39)<>(10))):B=FRE(K)+POS(Y<=Y):VTAB C%
90 GOTO 100:C=J:DEL 10,20:B=C:GOTO 30:REM! CLEAR CHAIN
100 P$(C%)=LEFT$(Z$,7)
110 C=(Y):AB=FRE(C)+POS(B):IF (((39>=5))*Z%) THEN RUN 80:REM! CLEAR CHAIN
120 M$="123"+RIGHT$(Z$,N2>=C):PRINT MID$(AB$,N2,35901)+STR$(39)+M$,RIGHT$(LEFT$(P$(X%),N2),K)+"TASC";
130 Z$=AB$+CHR$(Y):AB$=LEFT$(P$(A%-C%),-((AB<1.5)))
140 IF (C) THEN RUN 170:B=J
150 IF (TAN((X%)*((B-1)))) THEN RUN 40:GET K:J=K AND (NOT (((X%)+((908-1000)))))
160 AB$=P$(127)+Z$:IF (Z%) THEN SPEED=3.14159<=127*N2:IF (A%) THEN X%=X%:C=X% OR A%
170 AB=N2 OR 47409<=C% OR -5
180 Z$=RIGHT$(M$,15746):GOTO 140:REM! CLEAR COMMON
